0022600099.text: Milwaukee hosts Chicago as the Bucks' second game of the 2026-27 season, and neither team has played a game yet this season. The Bulls are missing Dailyn Swain and Jordan Hawkins, who are both out with illness, and Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury. The Bucks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, though their most recent meeting, on March 1, 2026 in Chicago, ended in a 120-97 loss.
